legend.EXT_INSTALLED: Installed and enabled addon; production use unverified
legend.PARTIAL: Some tech proven, larger workflow not complete
legend.RESEARCHED: Reference and control route documented, native production not validated
legend.VERSION_AVAILABLE: Available in current Blender release, integration unvalidated
legend.BLOCKED_QUALITY: Automated output fails artistic or motion review

entries.name: Asset Library & batch reuse
entries.ui: File > Asset Browser; Edit > Preferences > File Paths > Asset Libraries
entries.method: Mark reusable data-block as Asset, assign catalog, choose Link/Append/Reuse; not a duplicate project.

entries.name: Reusable procedural geometry systems
entries.ui: Select object > Properties > Modifiers > Add Modifier > Geometry Nodes; expose parameters in Group Interface
entries.method: Seeded generation, geometry fields, named attributes, variation without rebuilding topology.

entries.name: Profile-based lathe & architectural turned shapes
entries.ui: Edit Mode > select profile edges > Toolbar (T) Spin; adjust Steps & Angle in operator panel F9
entries.method: One accurate profile becomes column, vase, baluster, finial; parameterize revolution and add bevel/subdivision.

entries.name: High-end organic sculpting & proportion polish
entries.ui: Sculpting workspace; brush selector > Clay Strips/Crease/Draw Sharp; use Multires or remesh before detailing
entries.method: Anatomy silhouette first, secondary folds next, tertiary pores last; retopo/high-to-low normal bake; no generic blob acceptance.

entries.name: Production retopology and deformation loops
entries.ui: Modeling > mesh Edit Mode; Retopology Overlay, snapping Face, Shrinkwrap modifier
entries.method: Topology loops around joints, eyes and mouth, optimize high/low LOD preserving silhouette.

entries.name: Automated UV unwrapping & diagnostics
entries.ui: UV Editing workspace; Edit Mode select faces > U > Unwrap / Smart UV Project
entries.method: Demand no missing UVs and explicit seam strategy; do not assume generated Geometry Nodes cube UV named UVMap.

entries.name: High-fidelity authored PBR layers
entries.ui: Shading workspace > Principled BSDF; image color space: Base Color sRGB, Roughness/Normal Non-Color
entries.method: Reuse scanned legal texture sets, make artist masks for painted edges, dirt, color zones; exact roughness/normal management.

entries.name: Per-region asymmetric same-mesh color gradients
entries.ui: Shading > select Material > NW_AsymMultiObject_Gradient group inputs
entries.method: Two independent artist colors + strength + axis/offset + asymmetry + noise; local/object/world coordinate variant, preserves base texture.
entries.api: Material node group ShaderNodeGroup; TextureCoordinate / VectorMath DOT_PRODUCT

entries.name: Highpoly->lowpoly image texture baking
entries.ui: Render Properties > Cycles > Bake; select high and low; enable Selected to Active, set Cage/Extrusion
entries.method: Export real maps (normal, AO, roughness and opacity/cutout where relevant) for Unreal; choose cage clearance.

entries.name: Blender Studio CloudRig character rigging
entries.ui: Armature / Object Mode > CloudRig metarig controls; generate and test IK/FK in Pose Mode
entries.method: CloudRig 2.2.31 installed. Avoid replacing canonical KK skeleton; use control rig, bake onto actual deform bones.

entries.name: Koikatsu original identity and morph preservation
entries.ui: Import source GLB/FBX into isolated project; Outliner > armature > Shape Keys; compare base/rest pose and materials
entries.method: Do not treat import as reproduction: 121-bone count, 1,797 part-wise morph channels, but eye/stocking shader fidelity unresolved.
entries.api: glTF/FBX imported bones, shape_keys, armature + original texture links

entries.name: Facial expression shape-key library
entries.ui: Object Data Properties > Shape Keys; Timeline > key value, isolate mouth and eyelid controls
entries.method: Author smile/blink/speech/strong attack poses + corrective shape keys; preserve noncanonical privacy source.

entries.name: Automated mocap retarget with rest-pose alignment
entries.ui: Pose Mode; Retarget extension 5.2.0 > Bind, align source/target rest pose, Bake Constrained Actions
entries.method: Extension installed and automated bind tested. CMU source bent KK character badly; MUST correct rest pose/foot targets before accept.

entries.name: Reusable Actions and Action Slots
entries.ui: Dope Sheet > Action Editor, choose Action + Slot; NLA push down for reuse; Asset Browser pose assets
entries.method: Native 5.2 Actions can contain multiple Slots; bake real skeletal transformations and export actual animation not camera video.

entries.name: Combat choreography from licensed performed motion
entries.ui: Use reference/mocap library; bake adapted animation to deform skeleton; IK feet/hands and event phases
entries.method: CMU female punch captured/sliced; Unreal native 44 frames and 3 notify markers saved, motion visual quality not accepted.
entries.api: CMU BVH -> Blender F-curves -> UE IK Rig/Retargeter -> AnimSequence

entries.name: Foot/hand planted IK contact correction
entries.ui: Pose Mode > bone constraints > IK and Copy Location; Unreal Control Rig/Full Body IK for planted contacts
entries.method: Keep supports stationary, prevent sliding; character height and pelvis compensation must be verified per rig.
entries.api: bpy.ops.pose.*; IK Constraint; Unreal IK Retarget and Control Rig

entries.name: Automatic impact dynamics with rigid bodies
entries.ui: Object > Rigid Body > Add Active/Passive; Scene > Rigid Body World > Cache Bake
entries.method: Physics response not a hand-animated stack; export state events or simulate in Unreal Chaos for gameplay.

entries.name: Node-powered cloth stretch, tear and pinned controls
entries.ui: Add Modifier > Hair or Cloth node-based setup (5.2); expose pin/tear/stiffness parameters
entries.method: 5.2 node-powered cloth/hair is new and experimental. Source can tear, but KK in-game edit/UI and Unreal cloth fidelity remain unimplemented.
entries.api: Geometry Nodes physics groups; cache bake, no claim of game runtime parity

entries.name: Hair grooms, curves and dynamics
entries.ui: Sculpting > Hair curves; Geometry Nodes hair groups; modifiers & physics 5.2
entries.method: Use clumps, guide strips and follow strands, limited 8GB PC preview settings; runtime hair cards or UE Groom LOD.
entries.api: Curve Geometry, hair nodes, simulated attributes

entries.name: High-quality Grease Pencil v3 2D animation
entries.ui: 2D Animation workspace; Draw Mode, Dope Sheet > Grease Pencil, onion skin, keyed drawings
entries.method: Native 4.5 tested 14 drawings, 48-frame output. Artistic 2D quality not accepted; use held drawings and vector tweaks not 24 independent images/s.
entries.api: bpy.data.grease_pencils_v3; Grease Pencil Frames and Drawing.strokes

entries.name: Grease Pencil 5.2 precise fill and cels
entries.ui: Grease Pencil Draw Mode > Fill tool; material fill; multiframe onion skins
entries.method: 5.2 accelerated precise Delaunay fill; draw key poses, use masks and material palette, author smears only where needed.
entries.api: Grease Pencil v3 layers/materials; SVG export/FFmpeg previews not engine clips

entries.name: Anime-style beam, rings and procedural hit effects
entries.ui: Geometry Nodes/Shading for source effect mesh, then Unreal Niagara for runtime
entries.method: Animate source beam+shockwave+debris layers; drive Niagara spawn by actual attack notify; no MP4 as deliverable.
entries.api: GN meshes + material masks -> UE Niagara System + AnimNotify

entries.name: Film lighting and shot controls
entries.ui: Shading > World and Lights; Layout > Camera; Rendering > Cycles/Eevee settings
entries.method: Camera moves are cinematic previews only, never game character action. Cycles lookdev != Unreal toon shader parity.

entries.name: Reusable parametric preset libraries
entries.ui: Asset Browser > New Asset Catalog; select Geometry Nodes groups and Mark as Asset
entries.method: Version-matched source nodes and presets rather than one-off code; import as Linked/Append, keep asset origins.

entries.name: Blender to Unreal model/material export preflight
entries.ui: File > Export > FBX or glTF; preserve scale, axis, FBX armature root and texture packages
entries.method: Verified native UE imported meshes and AnimSequences, shader parity/Android quality still pending.
entries.api: bpy.ops.export_scene.fbx / gltf; UE AssetImportTask / IK Retargeter

entries.name: Gaea terrain graph to Unreal Landscape
entries.ui: Gaea Swarm --Filename --buildpath --resolution --seed; Gaea2Unreal bridge; Unreal Landscape weightmaps
entries.method: Gaea 2.3.1 installed, Swarm had remote-console invalid handle: no accepted terrain output or bridge import.
entries.api: Gaea Build Swarm -> heightmap masks JSON -> Unreal Landscape

entries.name: Headless native scene auditing and export
entries.ui: Scripting workspace > Python Console/Text Editor; command line blender --background --python script.py
entries.method: Safe batch runs. Prefer fresh process isolated worktree, explicit input/output and zero writes to foundation; dry-run before production.

entries.name: Mesh UV/material/rig/action audit
entries.ui: 3D View N sidebar > NoWorld Mastery > Run Read-only Audit
entries.method: One click reports object/mesh/UV/material/action/shape keys/rig and missing asset source; cannot judge aesthetics automatically.
